visualReview.scope: Detailed static current football exterior and open bowl.
visualReview.notes: All fourteen portable and fourteen shared frames inspected, plus full-resolution facade and orthographic placement views. Corrected outward-facing south walls, mapped North Stand closure, pitch-facing seat letters and turret rooflights are coherent. Exposed trusses, asymmetric stand heights, five divided window bands, brick bases, round entrance turrets, two-tier South Stand, HAMPDEN/saltire seating and video screens match the reference exterior character.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Shared brick, concrete, painted metal, standing-seam roof and gravel retain metric UV scale. Separate glazing stays portable PBR. Geographic sky-PMREM, terrain-hole hide/show restoration and model-unload assertions passed.

geographicReview.notes: Mapped pitch supplies the directed eastward long axis; South Stand towers and the oblique North Stand extension independently resolve orientation. Four actual stand ways replace the previously misleading stadium estate parcel, retained as rejected context. Orthographic frame follows the stand envelope; the explicit cutout protects the reconstructed below-forecourt pitch while public entrance feet remain at Y0.

fidelityReview.scope: Detailed published exterior in Molen shared material style.
fidelityReview.notes: Operator entrance photograph and hospitality brochure, Rangers 2024 aerial, Scottish FA screens photograph and the municipal North Stand planning dimensions establish the visible architecture. Other vertical dimensions, fine structural member spacing, local pitch-to-forecourt grade and exact chair inventory remain photographic reconstructions. Temporary sponsorship graphics and enclosed staff/interior rooms are outside the exterior scope; future redevelopment is excluded.
